# Sharon Aurelio Studio

> Brand and narrative strategy for architecture, engineering, and infrastructure (AEC) firms whose capability has outrun their story. Sharon Aurelio Studio surfaces the value already inside complex organizations, builds the narrative around it, and puts it to work across pursuits, awards, business development, and growth.

Sharon Aurelio is an architect who became a brand and narrative strategist — not a marketer who learned to speak architecture. Her career has been spent inside design practices, working alongside architects, engineers, and other technical experts across architecture, engineering, infrastructure, and adjacent markets (data centers, hospitality, mixed-use, aviation, maritime, federal, civic, and cultural work).

## Method

The Undersold Method: Site Read (see what is actually there), Narrative Build (find what is worth saying), Activation (give the story somewhere to go).

## Services

- Brand & Narrative Strategy — positioning, narrative architecture, brand integration, M&A integration, and the strategic systems that make complex capability legible
- Recognition & Visibility Strategy — awards, submissions, thought leadership, conference narratives, and recognition systems
- Pursuit Strategy — competitive-selection narratives connecting technical approach, differentiators, and client priorities into a clear reason to choose a firm

## Track record

- 87% successful design award submission rate across 195 submissions over 14 years
- $4M new revenue generated in the first quarter of a Hospitality practice launch
- $72M opportunity pipeline from four targeted client engagement activations
- $50M net revenue growth year over year
